sloka: सदासक्तं च तद्वेश्म सुमन्त्रः प्रविवेश ह ।तुष्टावास्य तदा वंशं प्रविश्य स विशां पतेः ॥२-१५-२०॥
transliteration: sadāsaktaṁ ca tadveśma sumantraḥ praviveśa ha ।tuṣṭāvāsya tadā vaṁśaṁ praviśya sa viśāṁ pateḥ ॥2-15-20॥

translations.english: Entering the king's inner apartment, he began extoling the virtues of the royal dynasty, and stood there as he approached the king's bedchamber.
